Pensée autour de l’air, de la lumière et: Designed around air, light and nature, its resort architecture opens a new page focused on childhood and stays by the sea. All its buildings have been listed as Historic Monuments since July 23, 2004.
Après le chantier, le site connaît plusi: After the construction site, the site experiences several lives. The Navy installed a torpedo school there in 1875, then a barracks. In the 1920s, the architect Clément Camus and the decorator André Hellé transformed the whole into a summer camp: La Maison Heureuse.
Dès 1803, un vaste ensemble est construi: From 1803, a large complex was built in Boyardville to house stores and housing for engineers, soldiers, craftsmen and workers involved in the construction of Fort Boyard. Nearly three hundred people could then be accommodated there.
